title: Gorgeous 3BR 30A Vacation Home with Beach and Pool Access
meta_description: Relax at A Slice of Lime, a 3BR, 2BA private home on 30A with beach access, a covered patio, a full kitchen, an outdoor shower, and a shared pool. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: Welcome to paradise! This gorgeous updated beach cottage is within easy walking distance to the beach and just steps to the community pool. The charming "A Slice of Lime" is just what you have been looking for! Sleeping 8, this retreat has been thoughtfully designed with families in mind and is set-up to be the perfect home-away-from-home.A covered patio greets you at the front of the home -- one of the many nooks this home boasts to enjoy a morning cup of coffee. As you walk through the front door, the calm neutrals with pops of Floridian charm will welcome you. The large comfy sectional is a great spot to relax with your family. The kitchen and dining area all share this open concept space. There is dining seating for 6 at the table and 2 spots at the kitchen peninsula. There's even an extra table at the front of the home that can be used as additional dining space or the perfect table for a game night!The kitchen is bright and white and ready for the chef in your group. Whip up some amazing gourmet meals or simply dole out the family's takeout from any of the wonderful nearby restaurants. Pizza? Mexican? Italian? All within walking distance!Head out to the backyard for an additional dining space, a covered seating area, a gas grill, and an outdoor shower for rinsing off the sand before heading in for the evening!Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: King bed and TV.Bedroom 2: King bed and TV.Bedrooms 1 and 2 share hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.Bedroom 3: King bed, TV and private bathroom with tub/shower combo.Full murphy bed in separate sleeping nook off living roomBeach Access:1.) Head out the subdivision and cross 30A.2.) Turn right onto the walking path -- take it down a few feet past The Palms to your beach access, labelled "Pelayo."Distance: .1 miles | Time: 3 minutes walkingGulf Mist:White picket fences adorn the well-kept lawns as you take a leisurely walk to this Seagrove Beach neighborhood pool. You will feel right at home in this cozy community of Gulf Mist beach cottages located directly across Scenic 30A from the beautiful beaches of South Walton. Make your way just down 30A to the beach access and you'll have your toes in the sand within minutes.Seagrove Beach:Named for the thick grove of oak trees lining its coastline, Seagrove Beach is located in the heart of 30A. The coastal villages of Seaside, Grayton, and WaterColor lie within a mile or two to the West, while Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and WaterSound lie a few miles East. There's no better spot to experience everything 30A has to offer!Your stay at A Slice of Lime comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 2 cars* Sorry, no pets allowedAn initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
